description: This file implements a search interface for the Notesnook app, allowing users to search and select notes, notebooks, or tags with dynamic filtering, expansion, and creation features.

classes.name: useNotebookExpandedStore
classes.description: A Zustand store managing the expanded/collapsed state of notebooks in the search UI.

classes.name: NotebookItem
classes.description: A React component representing a notebook item in the search, supporting expansion and selection.

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: A React component representing a note or tag item in the search results.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Main React component providing search functionality for notes, notebooks, and tags with filtering, creation, and selection features.

methods.name: checkQueryExists
methods.description: Checks if a tag with the given query exists in the database.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Performs a debounced search based on the current search keyword.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders either a NotebookItem or ListItem based on the mode.
